title: Prime Minister's Office (Monetary Authority of Singapore)
what_it_is: Prime Minister's Office (Monetary Authority of Singapore)

sections.label: Central banks and Singapore economy
sections.summary: Major central banks raised interest rates amid inflation, dampening inflation but slowing growth, and Singapore's economy will expand more slowly in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: Major central banks have increased interest rates at an unprecedented pace amid persistent inflationary pressures.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: Tighter financial conditions globally are helping to dampen inflation, at the cost of slower economic growth and increased financial market stresses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: Against this backdrop, the Singapore economy will expand at a slower pace in 2023.

sections.label: Financial services sector ITM targets
sections.summary: The ITM aims for 4%-5% growth and 3,000 to 4,000 net jobs created yearly in financial services over five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: The ITM aims to achieve growth of 4%-5% and net job creation of 3,000 to 4,000 per year for the financial services sector, over the five-year period.

sections.label: Upskilling financial sector workforce
sections.summary: MAS and the Institute of Banking & Finance will work with industry and tripartite partners to upskill the financial workforce and develop future capabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: MAS and the Institute of Banking & Finance will work closely with the industry and tripartite partners to continuously upskill the financial sector workforce and develop deep capabilities for the future of finance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for Social Policies (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
sentences.text: We will build competencies in growth areas, provide training support for finance professionals at different stages of their careers, develop specialist talent in areas, such as sustainability and technology, and groom future leaders in finance through opportunities to gain international exposure and build valuable networks.
